Reviewing DESIGN.md requirements for Alt+n preservation. The test must keep the accessible neutral todo fixture, existing labels and IDs, light and dark tokens, focus-only behavior without submission, and aria-keyshortcuts on the input.

tokens.css defines the light and dark color variables. index.html implements them and adds aria-keyshortcuts="Alt+n" to the input. The keydown handler blocks submission, focuses the input when no confirmation dialog is open, and preserves the existing form behavior.
